hints.title: Subtree Length Navigation
hints.text: For each internal node, check the length of string content held in the left branch to determine which branch contains the k-th character.

hints.title: Branch Choice
hints.text: If k is within the left child length, navigate into the left child; otherwise subtract the left length from k and navigate into the right child.

hints.title: Leaf Character Retrieval
hints.text: Upon reaching a leaf node holding raw string text, return the character at 0-indexed position k - 1.

hints.title: Rope Tree Character Retrieval Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterative branch descent using node length metadata.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Concatenating full tree string takes O(N) memory and time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space beyond tree nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses left child length metadata to navigate directly down the path containing index k.
